properties.title: Elrehan Azure Infrastructure Deployment Wizard (Subscription Scope)

steps.name: basics
steps.label: Basics
steps.description: Configure the deployment target, subscription, resource group, primary region, and tags.

elements.name: location
elements.label: Infrastructure Deployment Region
elements.toolTip: Select the Azure region where the infrastructure resources will be deployed. This can differ from the resource group region.

options.text: Cost Awareness: Network resources carry standard cloud charges. Virtual Machine deployment is optional and disabled by default (Pilot Safety Mode).

steps.name: networking
steps.label: Networking
steps.description: Create a new Virtual Network with dynamic subnets, or deploy into an existing Virtual Network across resource groups.

elements.name: vnetModeOptions
elements.label: Virtual Network Deployment Mode
elements.toolTip: Select whether to provision a new Virtual Network or reference an existing Virtual Network.

elements.name: vnetName
elements.label: Virtual Network Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the new Virtual Network (2-64 characters, alphanumeric and hyphens).

validations.message: VNet name must be between 2 and 64 characters.

elements.name: addressPrefix
elements.label: VNet Address Space (IPv4 CIDR)
elements.toolTip: The top-level IPv4 address prefix in CIDR notation (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16).

validations.message: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR prefix.

options.text: Subnet 1 (Mandatory Workload Subnet). Azure reserves 5 IP addresses per subnet. Sizing guide: /24 = 251 available IPs, /25 = 123, /26 = 59, /27 = 27, /28 = 11, /29 = 3 (smallest supported). Prefixes must be between /8 and /29.

elements.name: subnet1Name
elements.label: Subnet 1 Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the primary mandatory subnet (1-80 alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores).

validations.message: Subnet name must be between 1 and 80 characters.

elements.name: subnet1Prefix
elements.label: Subnet 1 CIDR Prefix
elements.toolTip: IPv4 CIDR prefix for Subnet 1 within the VNet address space. Supported Azure prefix lengths are /8 through /29.

validations.message: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR prefix between /8 and /29 (/30, /31, and /32 are unsupported by Azure).

elements.name: enableSubnet2
elements.label: Configure Subnet 2 (Optional)
elements.toolTip: Enable to configure an independent secondary subnet in this Virtual Network.

options.text: Subnet 2 (Optional Secondary Subnet). Sizing: /24 = 251 available IPs, /25 = 123, /26 = 59, /27 = 27, /28 = 11, /29 = 3. Must not overlap with Subnet 1 or Subnet 3.

elements.name: subnet2Name
elements.label: Subnet 2 Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the secondary subnet.

validations.message: Subnet name must be between 1 and 80 characters.

elements.name: subnet2Prefix
elements.label: Subnet 2 CIDR Prefix
elements.toolTip: IPv4 CIDR prefix for Subnet 2. Must be non-overlapping with other subnets.

validations.message: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR prefix between /8 and /29 (/30, /31, and /32 are unsupported by Azure).

elements.name: enableSubnet3
elements.label: Configure Subnet 3 (Optional)
elements.toolTip: Enable to configure an independent tertiary subnet in this Virtual Network.

options.text: Subnet 3 (Optional Tertiary Subnet). Sizing: /24 = 251 available IPs, /25 = 123, /26 = 59, /27 = 27, /28 = 11, /29 = 3. Must not overlap with Subnet 1 or Subnet 2.

elements.name: subnet3Name
elements.label: Subnet 3 Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the tertiary subnet.

validations.message: Subnet name must be between 1 and 80 characters.

elements.name: subnet3Prefix
elements.label: Subnet 3 CIDR Prefix
elements.toolTip: IPv4 CIDR prefix for Subnet 3. Must be non-overlapping with other subnets.

validations.message: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR prefix between /8 and /29 (/30, /31, and /32 are unsupported by Azure).

options.text: Subnet Naming Conflict: Subnet 1 and Subnet 2 have identical names. Subnet names must be unique (case-insensitive).
Subnet Naming Conflict: Subnet 1 and Subnet 3 have identical names. Subnet names must be unique (case-insensitive).
Subnet Naming Conflict: Subnet 2 and Subnet 3 have identical names. Subnet names must be unique (case-insensitive).
Subnet CIDR Conflict: Subnet 1 and Subnet 2 have identical CIDR prefixes. Subnet address ranges cannot overlap.
Subnet CIDR Conflict: Subnet 1 and Subnet 3 have identical CIDR prefixes. Subnet address ranges cannot overlap.
Subnet CIDR Conflict: Subnet 2 and Subnet 3 have identical CIDR prefixes. Subnet address ranges cannot overlap.
Targeting an existing VNet preserves all existing subnets, route tables, and peerings. Only Virtual Networks within the resource group selected in Basics are displayed.
A new resource group cannot contain existing virtual networks. Please select an existing resource group in Basics, or switch Virtual Network Deployment Mode to 'Create new virtual network'.
No existing Virtual Networks were found in the selected resource group. Please switch to 'Create new virtual network' or select a resource group in Basics that contains virtual networks.

elements.name: existingVnetDropDown
elements.label: Existing Virtual Network
elements.toolTip: Select an existing Virtual Network in the chosen resource group.

constraints.allowedValues: [map(steps('networking').existingVnetsApi.value, (item) => parse(concat('{"label":"', item.name, ' (', item.location, ')","value":{"id":"', item.id, '","name":"', item.name, '","location":"', item.location, '"}}')))]

options.text: The selected Virtual Network has no available subnets. Enable 'Deploy an additional subnet into this existing Virtual Network' below to create a subnet, or select a different Virtual Network.

elements.name: existingSubnetDropDown
elements.label: Target Existing Subnet
elements.toolTip: Select a subnet within the chosen Virtual Network to bind VM or security controls to.

constraints.allowedValues: [map(steps('networking').existingSubnetsApi.value, (item) => parse(concat('{"label":"', item.name, ' (', coalesce(item.properties.addressPrefix, first(item.properties.addressPrefixes), 'No CIDR'), ')","value":"', item.name, '"}')))]

elements.name: addNewSubnetToggle
elements.label: Deploy an additional subnet into this existing Virtual Network
elements.toolTip: Adds a new child subnet to the existing VNet without disrupting existing subnets or peerings.

validations.message: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR prefix.

steps.name: security
steps.label: Security
steps.description: Configure Network Security Groups (NSG) and secure traffic policies.

options.text: Network Security Groups enforce strict zero-trust defaults: SSH and RDP are restricted to VirtualNetwork internal address spaces and never exposed directly to the public internet.

allowedValues.label: Create new NSG with enterprise secure defaults (Internal management only)
Associate existing NSG (same or cross-resource group)

elements.name: existingNsgName
elements.label: Existing NSG Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the existing NSG to associate with the subnets.

elements.name: existingNsgResourceGroup
elements.label: Existing NSG Resource Group (Optional for Cross-RG)
elements.toolTip: Specify resource group name if the existing NSG is located in another resource group within this subscription.

steps.name: routing
steps.label: Routing
steps.description: Configure Route Tables, custom next-hop routes, and BGP propagation.

options.text: Route tables govern packet forwarding for workloads. BGP propagation control allows fine-grained control when peering with ExpressRoute or VPN Gateways.

allowedValues.label: Associate existing Route Table (same or cross-resource group)
No Route Table association (Default system routing)

elements.name: disableBgpRoutePropagation
elements.label: Disable BGP route propagation
elements.toolTip: Check this box to prevent on-premises routes learned via BGP from propagating to this route table.

elements.name: existingRouteTableName
elements.label: Existing Route Table Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the existing Route Table to associate with the subnets.

elements.name: existingRouteTableResourceGroup
elements.label: Existing Route Table Resource Group (Optional for Cross-RG)
elements.toolTip: Specify resource group name if the existing Route Table is located in another resource group.

steps.name: compute
steps.label: Virtual Machines
steps.description: Optionally provision a Virtual Machine for baseline validation.

elements.name: deployVmToggle
elements.label: Enable Virtual Machine Resource Deployment
elements.toolTip: Provision a pilot Virtual Machine attached to the selected subnet.

elements.name: osTypeOptions
elements.label: Operating System
elements.toolTip: Select Linux (Ubuntu 22.04 LTS) or Windows Server 2022 Datacenter.

elements.name: vmName
elements.label: Virtual Machine Name
elements.toolTip: 1-64 characters alphanumeric or hyphens.

validations.message: VM name must be 1 to 64 alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores.

elements.name: vmSizeLinux
elements.label: Virtual Machine Size (Linux Recommended)
elements.toolTip: Select an enterprise VM size recommended for pilot workloads.

allowedValues.label: Standard_D2s_v5 (2 vCPUs, 8 GiB memory - General Purpose)
Standard_D4s_v5 (4 vCPUs, 16 GiB memory - General Purpose)

elements.name: vmSizeWindows
elements.label: Virtual Machine Size (Windows Recommended)
elements.toolTip: Select a VM size with at least 8 GiB RAM for Windows Server performance.

allowedValues.label: Standard_D2s_v5 (2 vCPUs, 8 GiB memory - Recommended Windows Minimum)
Standard_D4s_v5 (4 vCPUs, 16 GiB memory - General Purpose)

elements.name: selectedSubnetName
elements.label: Target Subnet Name for VM NIC
elements.toolTip: Specify which subnet name the VM NIC will attach to.

validations.message: Username must be 1 to 64 alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores.

elements.name: adminSshPublicKey
elements.label: SSH Public Key (Linux)
elements.toolTip: OpenSSH public key (ssh-rsa or ssh-ed25519). ECDSA keys are rejected.

elements.name: adminPassword
elements.toolTip: Password between 12 and 123 characters with uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters.

constraints.validationMessage: Password must be 12 to 123 characters and satisfy complexity requirements.

steps.name: review
steps.label: Review
steps.description: Inspect deployment parameters, architecture summary, and cost warnings prior to submission.

options.text:
### Architecture & Deployment Summary

- **Target Scope:** Resource Group deployment via native Form View.
- **Networking:** Multi-tier Virtual Network (or targeted existing VNet with cross-RG support).
- **Security:** Network Security Group with enterprise-grade internal-only management access.
- **Routing:** Route Table with custom user-defined route capability.
- **Compute:** Optional Virtual Machine (Pilot safety mode defaults to disabled).

Proceed to the next tab to execute the native Azure Resource Manager client validation.
Zero Credential Exposure: Passwords and SSH private keys are never stored in template definitions or visible in portal reviews. Passwords remain masked at all times.

parameters.subnets: [if(equals(steps('networking').vnetModeOptions, 'new'), if(steps('networking').enableSubnet2, if(steps('networking').enableSubnet3, [parse(concat('{"name":"', steps('networking').subnet1Name, '","addressPrefix":"', steps('networking').subnet1Prefix, '"}')), parse(concat('{"name":"', steps('networking').subnet2Name, '","addressPrefix":"', steps('networking').subnet2Prefix, '"}')), parse(concat('{"name":"', steps('networking').subnet3Name, '","addressPrefix":"', steps('networking').subnet3Prefix, '"}'))], [parse(concat('{"name":"', steps('networking').subnet1Name, '","addressPrefix":"', steps('networking').subnet1Prefix, '"}')), parse(concat('{"name":"', steps('networking').subnet2Name, '","addressPrefix":"', steps('networking').subnet2Prefix, '"}'))]), if(steps('networking').enableSubnet3, [parse(concat('{"name":"', steps('networking').subnet1Name, '","addressPrefix":"', steps('networking').subnet1Prefix, '"}')), parse(concat('{"name":"', steps('networking').subnet3Name, '","addressPrefix":"', steps('networking').subnet3Prefix, '"}'))], [parse(concat('{"name":"', steps('networking').subnet1Name, '","addressPrefix":"', steps('networking').subnet1Prefix, '"}'))])), [parse('{"name":"snet-placeholder","addressPrefix":"10.0.0.0/24"}')])]
